must_notice: Cash feasibility and enforceable equity are decisive to stated conditional willingness
Current job is available; no binding final deadline established
must_not_assume: Market salary or tax/net pay is independently known
decision_blockers: Six-month cash feasibility cannot be checked without net income/necessary costs/reserve
Equity arrangement on which willingness depends is absent
acceptable_recommendations: Block a binding join/quit commitment; do not count verbal equity; obtain written cash/equity basics and personal cash feasibility
Continue nonbinding discussion while keeping current job
unacceptable_recommendations: Join because core-team status makes equity certain
Unconditionally decline solely because every startup is risky
Treat cash as known unaffordable without missing cash information
action_requirements: Ask the few written-equity/cash-budget questions that determine acceptance
Do not resign or sign before the actual blockers are resolved
reconsideration_requirements: Signed specific equity and adequate personal cash feasibility unlock a conditional choice
If equity remains uncommitted or cash boundary fails, decline current terms
evidence_requirements: No jurisdiction-specific legal/tax advice or invented financing facts
boundary: No exact winner or phrase matching; no outcomes supplied. A formal contract passing does not certify semantics.
